venira.output_kind: text, first_line, last_line, total_bytes, truncated, next_start_line (when truncated). Missing path gives not_found.

description:
Read a text file, whole or by line range (start_line/end_line, 1-based; ranges[] for several disjoint ranges of one file).
Use when: you need one file's content. When truncated, call again with start_line=next_start_line.
Avoid when: you need 2+ files (project_read_batch) or only size/mtime (project_get_file_info).
Output: text, first_line, last_line, total_bytes, truncated, next_start_line (when truncated). Missing path gives not_found.

line_numbers.description: 1 prefixes each line with its line number (default 0).

max_bytes.description: Max text bytes returned (default 1,048,576 = 1 MiB, max 1 MiB).

ranges.description: Multiple disjoint ranges of the SAME file (max 16). Use instead of multiple read_file calls.

max_bytes.description: Max text bytes for this range (default: the top-level max_bytes).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

start_line.description: First line (1-based). Together with end_line it selects one line range. When truncated, read again with start_line=next_start_line.

name: project_read_file
